svg.aria-label: L11 Prefetch lineage: access maps, a global history, pointer scans and a pollution filter
svg.text: L11 Prefetch lineage: access maps, a global history, pointer scans and a pollution filter
Left, four published prefetchers redrawn. Right, what the M1 measures as and what the patents add. Between them, what was kept, changed and added.
Ishii 2011 Fig. 2, 3; Nesbit 2004 Fig. 1b; Cooksey 2002 Fig. 2; Srinath 2007 Fig. 4; Somogyi 2006 Fig. 3
M1 prefetchers, trained at the LSU
the pointer chaser measured; the rest patents
AMPM: one map per zone, two bits per line
tag, PC and offset, pattern bits
Somogyi: a region pattern per trigger PC
global history buffer: a FIFO of misses, linked by key
content directed: scan a filled line for address like values
feedback directed: a pollution filter and a level
accuracy, lateness, pollution set the level
Nesbit: the history is global, the key picks a thread
Cooksey: the scan runs in the L2 fill path
Srinath: a demand miss that finds its bit set is pollution
a filter and a throttle level
at the LSU, every load and store
deny list of evicted unused lines
non temporal loads skip the L1
access maps and strides: 16 streams matched against patterns
a temporal history a little under 256 entries
the pointer chaser, measured: one level, 3 accesses, 64 KiB reach
a chase across pages keeps its L1 latency
the pointer and its line share one 4 GiB region
the deny list and the L2 rater, from patents
measured: 16 streams, 8 KiB strides, the chaser and its limits, the 15 KiB region
patents: the deny list, the rater
open: access map and temporal history, one table or two
